privileged_info_for_vlm: The criteria for a High-Risk Health Zone are: AQI > 75, population density > 3500, and distance to hospital > 7.5km. The qualifying census tracts are: CT-003, CT-007, CT-011, CT-014, CT-016, CT-018, and CT-020. The final output must be a GeoJSON file located at /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/high_risk_zones.geojson.
